unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted); no '(**)' cells occur in this section. Values as printed, thousands separators stripped, negatives as leading '-'. Full visual render and cid-decoded text-layer cross-check completed for page 20. Each Applicable column has exactly one source (Proprietary Receipts), so its line-level cell is standalone and the section-total Applicable cell is covered by the exact total-row net identity. Prior-FYTD Gross and Net column roll-ups require tol 1 under the printed rounding note.
